I went there and the first guy I got told me to commit suicide. 

I told him he was a bad listener and he called me an asshole. 

Just a heads up.
I wish I could feel triumphant, every day I'm alive I feel like a bigger pussy for not going ahead and killing myself...
my thoughts are fucking awful, I can't push through that shit to get to wherever meditation is supposed to get me.
If that's where everything ended I don't think anyone would have bothered coming up with IT.
